$comment: Reviewed allowlist for the branding gate (scripts/check-branding.ts, VOR-3). Each entry exempts a path prefix (repo-relative), optionally narrowed to specific rule ids. Classes: wire-contract (must never change — roadmap/upstream/compatibility.md), upstream-internal (upstream-owned files/demo data), flip-sync (static yml/json/html that cannot import TS — the rebrand flip ticket must sweep these in the same PR as the branding.ts value change), flip-deferred (source intentionally deferred to the flip ticket). Adding an entry requires PR review — do not exempt new product code; import from @craft-agent/shared/branding instead.
